name: bws-cockpit
description: Run Cockpit band, Editor & Device Guard for Unreal/Unity/Blender/adb, Loop Watch pane for harness loops, and a Finish-Line Guard that keeps Claude going while the run checklist has open items.

guard.title: Editor & Device Guard
guard.description: Block calls that cannot work (editor or device down) and add launch flags (Unity -automated, UE low-VRAM).

lowVramMode.title: UE low-VRAM flags
lowVramMode.description: auto: add them when another UE editor or Blender runs, or VRAM use is over the threshold. always / off.

vramThresholdMb.title: VRAM threshold (MB)
vramThresholdMb.description: In auto mode, VRAM in use at or above this counts as pressure.

lowVramCvars.title: Low-VRAM cvars
lowVramCvars.description: Comma-separated cvar=value pairs passed as -ini:Engine:[SystemSettings] overrides. Empty uses the built-in set.

refreshSeconds.title: Band refresh (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the band re-probes editors and devices while a terminal or Desktop surface is attached.

loopIdleMinutes.title: Loop: idle alert (minutes)
loopIdleMinutes.description: Alert when the running worker has made no tool call for this long.

loopSessionAlert.title: Loop: session alert
loopSessionAlert.description: Alert when the current unit reaches this many worker sessions.

loopDriverStaleMinutes.title: Loop: dead-driver alert (minutes)
loopDriverStaleMinutes.description: Alert when the driver says RUNNING but its 30-second heartbeat has not updated for this long.

finishLine.title: Finish-Line Guard
finishLine.description: Keep Claude going when this session's run folder still has open checklist items, and ask for evidence when it claims done without any.

finishLineMaxContinues.title: Finish line: continues per prompt
finishLineMaxContinues.description: How many times the guard may block a stop before your next prompt.

evidenceCheck.title: Finish line: evidence check
evidenceCheck.description: Block once when a reply claims the work is done but cites no evidence (test counts, receipt paths, commit hash).

finishLineHeadless.title: Finish line in headless sessions
finishLineHeadless.description: Also guard claude -p and SDK sessions (off by default so harness workers keep their own budgets).

ownerName.title: Finish line: your name
ownerName.description: What the Finish-Line Guard calls you when it asks Claude to mark an item that needs you, as in "(needs <name>: question)".
